scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is for connected chain graphs in canonical twin-class form. The complete-bipartite specialization is prior coverage, and the minimum Roman domination number is presented only as a corollary. Exact brute-force verification covers every positive canonical profile through order 9 but is not used as an infinite proof. Full text of the directly relevant 2020 chain-graph minimum-optimization paper was not accessible from the lawful sources available during review; that access risk is retained explicitly.
title: Roman domination polynomial of chain graphs
